notes: Paper reports exclusion of axion decay constants f_a below 9.4×10^12 − 1.8×10^10 GeV for axion masses in the range 1.7×10^−23 − 8.7×10^−21 eV at 95% CL, derived from 12 years of tritium-3 beta decay data from the European Commission's Joint Research Centre. The mechanism is oscillations of the effective θ angle induced by axion dark matter misalignment, which modulate nuclear binding energies and hence decay rates. The exclusion curve is presented in Fig. 3 as a boundary in the (m_a, 1/f_a) plane. Data points represent the endpoints of the excluded region. DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm³ is the standard galactic halo value used in the analysis (Eq. 12).
